name: Infosys Ltd

business.about: Infosys Ltd provides consulting, technology, outsourcing and next-generation digital services to enable clients to execute strategies for their digital transformation. [1] It is the 2nd largest Information Technology company in India behind TCS. [2]
business.key_points: Digital Services: It comprises of services and solution offerings of the group that enables clients to transform their businesses. It includes offerings that enhance customer experience, leverage AI-based analytics and big data, engineer digital products and IoT, modernize legacy tech systems, migrate to cloud applications and implement advanced cyber-security systems. [1]

delivery_comments.quote: Q1 revenue growth was lower than our expectations, mainly due to - one-off 50 basis point impact on account of program termination by an EURS client during the quarter.
Volumes were soft and weaker than expectations and also versus the historical Q1 trends
client expectation on productivity, along with high competitive intensity is resulting in softer increase in price versus our expectations.
Despite lower-than-expected growth, gross margins improved by 60 bps sequentially. Operating margin improved by 20 bps sequentially to 21.1%.

delivery_comments.quote: FY26 revenues crossed $20 bn and grew 3.1% in constant currency terms, within the upgraded guidance band given in January.
Adjusted operating margin was stable at 21%.
Large deals were very good, $14.9 bn for the full year, $3.2 bn for the fourth quarter. The full year was 28% higher than it was in the previous year.
Volumes for the year were flattish, growth was led by increase in realization thanks to Project Maximus.

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Management noted Q2 FY27 volume soft and revenue growth below expectations.
narrative_vs_numbers.reality: Q2 FY27 sales grew 10.7% YoY to ₹49,244 crore.

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Management reported FY26 constant currency revenue growth of 3.1%.
narrative_vs_numbers.reality: FY26 rupee sales grew 9.6% YoY to ₹178,650 crore.

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Management guided FY27 operating margin at 20% to 22%.
narrative_vs_numbers.reality: Reported OPM stayed higher at 24.0% in Q1 and Q2 FY27.

bull.point: Operating margin consistently held at 24.0% through FY25, FY26, and H1 FY27.
bull.cite: FY26 opm and Q2 FY27 opm

bull.point: Sales growth accelerated to double digits in Q1 FY27 (14.0%) and Q2 FY27 (10.7%).
bull.cite: Q1 FY27 sales_yoy and Q2 FY27 sales_yoy

bull.point: Strong cash flow from operations reached ₹33,986 crore in FY26.

bear.point: PAT growth slowed sharply to 6.3% YoY in Q2 FY27 from 12.3% in Q1 FY27.
bear.cite: Q2 FY27 pat_yoy and Q1 FY27 pat_yoy

bear.point: Borrowings increased to ₹9,176 crore in FY26 from ₹8,227 crore in FY25.
Management cited softer volumes and low pricing power in Q2 FY27.
bear.cite: Q2 FY27 call p6 and Q2 FY27 call p27

verdict: Management consistently beats conservative margin guidance, but qualitative call commentary remains overly cautious despite strong top-line sales performance.
